{{Draft}}
Every record in openCR has a '''main form''' with its basic data, and '''sections''' for information that can occur more than once. An artwork, for example, can have several titles, several measurements (image, sheet, frame) and a long ownership history; each of these is a list of entries in its own section.

This page lists the sections of each entity, named as they appear in the forms. For the overall picture, see [[How openCR is structured]].

== Objects (artworks) ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Section !! What goes there
|-
| Titles || Further titles of the work: alternative, translated, or as used in a particular publication
|-
| Components || What the work is made of: oil, canvas, paper, acrylic, etching and so on
|-
| Object Measurements || Dimensions, one entry per measured extent (for example image, sheet, frame)
|-
| Object attributes || Marks and inscriptions: signed, dated, numbered, stamped, with their position and transcription
|-
| Parts || The named parts of a multi-part work, such as the panels of a triptych
|-
| Images || Photographs of the work
|-
| Editions || The editions of a print: regular edition, artist's proofs, trial proofs and so on
|-
| Sculpture editions || The casts of a sculpture
|-
| Agents || People and institutions involved with the work: printer, publisher, foundry, photographer, co-author
|-
| Reference || The literature that mentions or reproduces the work
|-
| Objects provenance || The ownership history
|-
| Objects transactions || Sales and auctions
|-
| Exhibitions || The exhibitions where the work was shown
|-
| Notes || Notes about the work meant for publication
|-
| Object tags || The artist's tags that apply to this work
|-
| Relation with other objects || Links to other works: study for, copy of, version of and similar
|-
| Objects Actions || Dated events in the life of the work, such as signing, printing or restoration
|}

== Artists ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Section !! What goes there
|-
| Biographies || The biography texts, one per language and type (life biography or art-historical biography)
|-
| Communications || Phone numbers, email addresses, websites, social media
|-
| Relations || Links to people and institutions: gallerist, publisher, family, mentor, heir and others
|-
| Collections || Institutions that hold works by the artist
|-
| Tags || The artist's own keywords for grouping artworks
|-
| Selected Languages || The languages the artist's catalogue is meant to be published in
|-
| Definition of categories || The artist's own sub-categories of artworks, used for filtering the catalogue
|-
| Object Templates || Default values for new artworks, for example the usual paper of a print series
|-
| External file || Documents attached to the artist
|}

== Publications ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Section !! What goes there
|-
| Publications Agents || Authors, editors, publishers and other contributors
|-
| Featured artists || The artists the publication is about, and whether it appears on the website or in the printed catalogue
|-
| Related events || Events the publication documents, for example the exhibition an exhibition catalogue accompanies
|-
| Used languages || The languages the publication is written in
|-
| Publications Relations || Links to other publications: part of, version of, copy or facsimile of, based on and similar
|-
| Reference || The artworks that cite this publication
|-
| Externalfiles || Attached files, such as scans
|}

== Events ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Section !! What goes there
|-
| Event description || The name and description of the event, per language
|-
| Locations || Where and when the event took place; a touring exhibition has several
|-
| Events Artists || The artists who took part, and in which role
|-
| Events Agents || The people and institutions involved: organiser, curator, gallery, sponsor
|-
| Exhibited objects || The artworks shown, with lender and the title used in the exhibition
|-
| Related publications || Publications documenting the event
|}

== Directory ==
{| class="wikitable"
! Section !! What goes there
|-
| Activities || What the person or institution does: gallery, publisher, photographer, curator and so on
|-
| Contact inform. || Phone numbers, email addresses, websites
|-
| Directory Relations || Links between directory entries, for example between a person and an institution
|-
| Directory Artists || The artists' catalogues in which this entry is used
|}
The directory form also shows where an entry is used elsewhere: in ownership histories (''Objects provenance''), sales (''Objects transactions''), events (''Events Agents'') and publications (''Publications Agents'').
